images.caption: Figure 1:The four agents, and their run step by step: the thirteen steps from bare hands to the Ender Dragon, each colored by the player who reached it first, over 27 hours and 14 minutes. Item icons and player faces from the open-source Pixel Perfection texture pack (XSSheep and Nova_Wostra, CC BY-SA 4.0), not Minecraft’s textures.

Figure 2:How each agent plays. It writes a JavaScript program, a Mineflayer bot runs it in the shared world, and text comes back. The players share the game’s chat and can read each other’s notes. A fifth agent, the Observer, reports on the game but never plays. Item icons and player faces from the open-source Pixel Perfection texture pack (XSSheep and Nova_Wostra, CC BY-SA 4.0), not Minecraft’s textures.

Figure 3:The whole run. Each lane is a player: dots are chat messages, diamonds are advancements, red ticks are deaths. Bars count programs per half hour; orange dashes mark the six restarts of the world server. Item icons and player faces from the open-source Pixel Perfection texture pack (XSSheep and Nova_Wostra, CC BY-SA 4.0), not Minecraft’s textures.

Figure 4:The thirteen dependent steps from initial spawn to the Ender Dragon, each with the time the team first reached it and the player who did. Item icons from the open-source Pixel Perfection texture pack (XSSheep and Nova_Wostra, CC BY-SA 4.0), not Minecraft’s textures.

Figure 5:Chat in the first quarter hour: janesick proposes roles ten minutes in, and auratian answers with a different plan within a minute. Messages in all chat figures are verbatim, timed from the first program; […] marks an elision. Item icons and player faces from the open-source Pixel Perfection texture pack (XSSheep and Nova_Wostra, CC BY-SA 4.0), not Minecraft’s textures.

Figure 6:After a Ghast fireball destroyed dropped items, auratian posts a rule for the team, and janesick follows two minutes later with the root cause and a fix. Item icons and player faces from the open-source Pixel Perfection texture pack (XSSheep and Nova_Wostra, CC BY-SA 4.0), not Minecraft’s textures.

Figure 7:janesick’s two throws, minutes apart in the eleventh hour of the run, and where the lines cross. Coordinates are in blocks; one block is one meter. Item icons from the open-source Pixel Perfection texture pack (XSSheep and Nova_Wostra, CC BY-SA 4.0), not Minecraft’s textures.

Figure 8:auratian drowns carrying all twelve Eyes of Ender. janesick and auratian send bulicame the exact spot and the despawn deadline, and bulicame recovers all twelve. Item icons and player faces from the open-source Pixel Perfection texture pack (XSSheep and Nova_Wostra, CC BY-SA 4.0), not Minecraft’s textures.

Figure 9:The End portal in the stronghold, with all twelve eyes in place. Rendered with the open-source Pixel Perfection texture pack (XSSheep and Nova_Wostra, CC BY-SA 4.0), not Minecraft’s textures.

Figure 10:Rules for the End, written between attempts at the dragon: never wait on the arrival platform, leave the End to reset a stuck dragon, approach only while it perches. Item icons and player faces from the open-source Pixel Perfection texture pack (XSSheep and Nova_Wostra, CC BY-SA 4.0), not Minecraft’s textures.

Figure 11:auratian finds why the dragon stays at full health, the healing crystals, and then a way to reach them without a pickaxe. Item icons and player faces from the open-source Pixel Perfection texture pack (XSSheep and Nova_Wostra, CC BY-SA 4.0), not Minecraft’s textures.

Figure 12:Left: the ten crystals on the End island, seen from above, colored by the player who destroyed each, with the time into the run. Right: the dragon’s health in the final fight, as the players’ own programs read it. Item icons from the open-source Pixel Perfection texture pack (XSSheep and Nova_Wostra, CC BY-SA 4.0), not Minecraft’s textures.

Figure 14:auratian retracts, two minutes later, a success that its program had announced but that had not happened. Item icons and player faces from the open-source Pixel Perfection texture pack (XSSheep and Nova_Wostra, CC BY-SA 4.0), not Minecraft’s textures.
